answers.core: while this new button type could be made as an addon, it won't be present in the editor UI, so it has to be core. Many tool projects and game options menus would also benefit from such a button type.
answers.workaround:
it can be done manually, but part of the benefit is improving the editor, which can't be done easily.
Also, it would be benefited from often, and used from time to time in tools made with godot.

title: Allow `OptionButton`s to expand to a horizontal list of options
